data.name: Mutmain
data.gender_notes: Mutmain is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'mutmana' which means to be secure, to feel comfort and safety. The name Mutmain carries the meaning “Secure, Comforted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mutmain usually hope their child will grow to embody secure, comforted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a child who is believed to be spiritually strong and protected by Allah
data.etymology: Mutmain belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Secure, Comforted.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mutmain total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
